PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 6.5.438, legacy build, Apache-2.0.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Documentation: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/api/
Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.5.438

Vendored files: parser/display module, parser worker, standard fonts, image/color decoders and their licenses.
PDF sandbox and QuickJS execution modules are NOT included or called by Nexo.
Nexo uses byte input, text extraction and canvas rendering only, with XFA disabled.
The legacy build includes compatibility polyfills needed by Node 22/24 and older browsers.
No user documents belong in this vendor directory.
